messages:
anna: Heads-up: ran into a card that passes our 6h hot-soak but fails after an overnight cold boot. Repro notes incoming.
sanjay: ugh. which rack/node? did it show XIDs or ECC spikes?
anna: rack12/node4. Logs show repeated Xid 13 after node idle, then a bunch of NVidia driver resets. ECC counters bumped slightly before the first Xid.
jules: can you paste the short logs? also did we try a power-cycle-only vs full AC disconnect?
anna: short log snippet:
```
[ 12:34:01 ] gpu0: ECC single-bit errors rising: 0 -> 3
[ 12:36:10 ] Xid(13): GPF: GPU hang, attempt reset
[ 12:36:12 ] driver: GPU reset succeeded
[ 12:43:58 ] after suspend/resume -> Xid(13) repeat
```
maria: I tried a cold boot yesterday on similar failures and saw them only after an S0->S5 full power down. Warm reboot did not reproduce.
bench-bot: recommended test profile: `coldboot-ripple-2h` (mem patterns + mixed fp32 kernels + kernel-space PCIe rescan every 10m)
anna: plan proposed:
- drain node (k8s drain --ignore-daemonsets)
- full AC disconnect + wait 60s
- boot into diag image (ubuntu-diag-rc)
- run soakbench `--profile coldboot-ripple-2h --seed random --log-level debug`
- collect nvml counters every minute
- if repro, tag card and run extended 24h cold-cycle loop
sanjay: +1. add bios setting check: PCIe ASPM, PCIe Gen lock, and mem ECC mode. Sometimes BIOS toggles after FW update.
jules: also try `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,EE` snapshot pre/post. If Xid shows, capture `dmesg -T` and `lspci -vvv`.
anna: noted. Quick question: do we prefer immediate RMA on repro or escalate to 24h cold loop first? cost tradeoff vs capacity impact.
maria: for customer-facing pools we should prefer quick RMA if repro occurs within first 6h of cold cycle. For bench/overflow pools, 24h loop first.
ops-bot: reminder: draining triggers dedicated-capacity autoscaler; notify capacity oncall if more than 3 nodes in rack are drained.
sanjay: also add a lightweight A/B: same card in another host (swap riser) to rule out riser/backplane.
anna: will run swap if initial repro persists. I'll schedule a 2h window tonight and post short results here. cc @jules @maria :thumbsup:
bench-bot: command for run:
```
ssh root@rack12-node4 
systemctl isolate diag.target
/opt/soakbench/bin/soakbench --profile coldboot-ripple-2h --duration 7200 --out /tmp/soak-$(date +%s).log
nv-sample --interval 60 --out /tmp/nvml-$(date +%s).csv &
```
jules: thanks. if repro, capture a full system telemetry tarball and upload to /mnt/infra-fleet-logs/rack12/node4/2323456789
anna: will do. posting quick followup in ~3h with status. thanks team.
